completed_missions.title: Build persistent 11-agent Hixton swarm
completed_missions.result: Eleven role contracts, persistent knowledge, regression protocol and GitHub-hosted cloud orchestration were established. Legacy laptop-bound engineering launchers and local agent runners were removed.

completed_missions.title: Complete USDT to USDC migration audit, explain backtest delta, repair defects, retest
completed_missions.result: The complete A01-A11 chain passed after repairs. No supported USDT-to-USDC strategy/code defect explains the historic 733-versus-about-203 difference. The dominant difference is the non-equivalent account path: the old USDT reference carried prior equity/positions into the later period, while the later USDT/USDC controls restarted fresh. On the same fresh-start window USDC slightly outperformed USDT. Persistent portfolio drawdown/risk halting explains most rejected entries on the fresh path. Paper/shared-portfolio parity matched exactly under equivalent assumptions.

active_mission.title: Hixton 0.5.0 max-capital product release
active_mission.objective: Release one coherent V6 system where UI, exact-three-year portfolio backtest, Paper and normal Live consume the same saved max_capital_usdc and CAPITAL-V1-2X50PCT allocator; preserve isolated 10x250 as coin research and the separate controlled 1x50 Binance round-trip; make Trial/Live execution continuously observable with Binance completion, timing, parity and patch/source identity evidence.
active_mission.last_transition_reason: The canonical AVAX/DOGE promotion is active as V6 c78c8cabf980; the stale DOGE product-contract assertion was repaired. Owner requires one final exact-head run where Preflight, Dashboard E2E, Coin Optimization and A01-A11 all validate the same downloadable commit before distribution.
constraints: UI exposes one editable capital value only: max_capital_usdc. Slot count, tranche size, reserve and allocation policy are derived and not separate user truths.

CAPITAL-V1-2X50PCT derives two ranked_repeat tranches at 50 percent each across the configurable 100..1000000-USDC product range; default 250 -> 2x125. Historical capital research/reference remains bounded separately and is not a real-liquidity guarantee.
Portfolio backtest, Paper and normal Live consume the same saved max_capital_usdc and central capital_plan; any mismatch fails closed.
The first real-money stage remains a separate explicit 1x50 USDC round-trip. Arming it sends no immediate/backfilled order and does not rewrite max_capital_usdc.

Continuous Live requires a completed/reconciled Binance BUY+SELL 1x50 round-trip, a fresh safe action-time Binance account/API/market check, healthy runtime and a persisted capital-plan binding. Paper soak is operational evidence, not an additional post-trial Live unlock gate.
Changing max_capital_usdc while a Live ledger is active must stop new entries and may not silently resize an active plan.
10x250 isolated remains coin-optimization research only. Candidate discovery is isolated; portfolio compatibility is checked against the canonical max-budget portfolio.
All ten coin profiles come from one canonical V6 map. Current promoted deltas include XRP CMO 0.15, AVAX band 5.2 and DOT CMO 0.35.
Exact product backtests cover three calendar years backwards from the end time plus 400 warm-up bars and fail closed on insufficient history.
Cloud A01-A11 remain key-free and must not send real or testnet orders or request private Binance credentials.
No historical simulation may be presented as guaranteed future performance or proof of historical Binance fills.
The 1x50 and normal Live actions perform their sufficient Binance account preflight automatically; the separate manual connection check is diagnostic only.

Trial and Live bind application/source/strategy/allocator identity. A stale execution source may never open a new position; owned/unresolved positions may continue only through monitored EXIT_ONLY/reconciliation.

A secret-free live-execution-report.json is mandatory for 24x7 operation and must include Binance terminal/fill evidence, full round-trip completion, unresolved intents, signal-to-submit timing, Paper-vs-Live parity and frozen-vs-current execution identity.
Any patch that changes execution/runtime/strategy/order/report semantics invalidates prior Live-readiness evidence and requires fresh A01-A11 validation on the exact new head.

CAPITAL_BUDGET_AUDIT must not assume CAPITAL-V1-2X50PCT is optimal. Treat current 250 -> 2x125 ranked_repeat as the production baseline only until fresh evidence compares it against higher-slot layouts.
At minimum compare the same 250-USDC total budget as 2x125, 3x~83.33, 4x62.50 and 5x50 with no leverage and no increase in total capital; additional layouts may be explored only as research.

Every compared layout must use the identical exact-three-year window, canonical V6 coin profiles, costs, execution model, Binance filters and risk assumptions so slot layout is the controlled variable.

Capital-layout evidence must report net PnL/return, max drawdown, completed position cycles, slot trades, wins/losses, average holding time, median/average/longest entry gap, hours with zero/partial/full slot occupancy, NO_FREE_SLOT blocks and baseline/stress results.

The audit must explicitly test whether 5x50 converts materially more of the ten-coin signal opportunity into executed trades than 2x125 without unacceptable degradation in net performance or drawdown.

No capital-layout candidate is automatically promoted to Paper or Live. Any change from 2x125 requires A10 synthesis, A09 independent QA, A11 governance and a fresh exact-head release-validation round.

CAPITAL_BUDGET_AUDIT must include a true 5x50 one_per_symbol layout so the owner question means up to five different simultaneous coin positions, not merely five ranked_repeat slots that can stack on one signal.
A controlled 50-USDC trial PASS requires proving the complete BUY->owned OPEN->SELL->account reconciliation lifecycle, not merely proving a BUY route exists.
No test may count Binance ACK as a fill; actual order status plus persisted myTrades fill details are required for simulated success.
Disabling new entries, losing entry release, or becoming DEGRADED after an owned BUY must not silently liquidate foreign assets and must not prevent the canonical owned-position exit path.
Any ambiguous submitted BUY or SELL must be queried by durable clientOrderId and must never be automatically resubmitted.
COMPLETED requires fresh reconciliation of balances, open orders, locked balances and residual quantity after SELL.
Backtest/Paper/Trial/Live strategy parity means the same canonical strategy/profile/signal/exit semantics; it does not mean identical live fill price, fees, slippage or PnL.
A11 must reject any cloud statement that a real Binance order was filled; only the local authenticated runtime can establish that fact.
Coin optimization remains research-only and must not disturb the locally armed controlled 1x50-USDC trial.
Every coin is judged separately; aggregate portfolio improvement cannot hide an individual coin regression.
A target of improving all ten coins is aspirational, not permission to weaken validation/full-window/stress/drawdown gates or select on the holdout.
Use prior Top-8, robust finalists and loss clusters to construct bounded second-stage searches for unresolved coins rather than unbounded brute force.

Recover the preserved stale Paper state before treating continuous runtime evidence as healthy; authorize only the exact fbd1b842f4f9 -> b271d7952d15 Paper-only transition, with no reset and no real/testnet orders.
Do not repeat the latest documented local grids unchanged; new work must be evidence-led and coin-specific.
A serious coin challenger must show isolated baseline/stress and canonical 250-USDC portfolio baseline/stress plus trade/slot deltas before promotion.
ETH momentum19-vs20 must be explained counterfactually at slot-collision level before broader ETH search.
Coin-profile experiments and allocator/ranking experiments are separate causal workstreams and may not be changed together.
Promote only AVAX ATR 150 and DOGE momentum16/smoothing14/ATR120/band4.3; no other coin profile or allocator change is allowed in the promotion commit.
The promoted canonical V6 strategy identity must be HIXTON-V6-COIN-PAPER-1-c78c8cabf980.
All distribution evidence must be regenerated on the exact promotion commit; stale b271d7952d15 evidence is invalid for release.
The final download must be pinned to the exact validated commit SHA rather than a moving branch archive.
acceptance: A01 proves README/DMS/AGENTS/swarm docs describe max_capital_usdc, CAPITAL-V1-2X50PCT, 10x250 research separation, automatic action-time preflight, the separate 1x50 trial and the mandatory 24x7 Live execution report without stale product gates.

A02 produces a fresh exact-three-year dashboard portfolio E2E using default 250-USDC max budget -> 2x125 ranked_repeat and a fresh isolated 10x250 optimization recheck against the same canonical portfolio.
A03 proves Paper/backtest/Live signal and allocator parity, including ranked_repeat, restart persistence and report-visible Paper-vs-Live action/version discrepancies.

A04 proves shipped UI has exactly one editable max-capital field, protected local credentials, automatic 1x50/Live action checks, 1x50 trial/max-budget Live controls and a protected secret-free Live report/download surface.

A05 validates 24x7 runtime liveness plus persistent Paper state and treats stale reports, unresolved Binance execution, source mismatch or delayed owned exits as incidents rather than healthy idle time.

A06 passes the full regression suite including duplicate/retry/timeout/restart/budget-change handling, 1x50 BUY/SELL reconciliation, stale-patch new-entry blocking, EXIT_ONLY recovery, timing classification and secret-free report generation.
A07 verifies public Binance Spot USDC markets/filters and that report semantics distinguish local intents from actual terminal Binance FILLED orders without requiring private credentials in cloud.

A08 verifies default 250 -> 2x125 risk/slot limits, 10x250 research separation and that recorded Trial/Live entries/exits correspond to the active strategy version without early/stale-patch execution.
A10 accepts evidence only when A01-A08 satisfy the max-budget and mandatory Live-monitoring contract and routes every report incident to repair with downstream evidence invalidation.

A09 emits QA_PASS only from fresh exact-head evidence including source/strategy/allocator binding, report/UI tests, Binance terminal/fill/reconciliation semantics and stale-patch/EXIT_ONLY regressions.

A11 emits GOVERNANCE_PASS only after fresh QA_PASS and complete A01-A10 Live-monitoring evidence; it refuses stale-patch execution or any claim that an actual Binance roundtrip occurred without owner-side proof.
The shipped static UI displays Hixton 0.5.0 and the release commit is identical to the tested/downloadable commit.

A02 produces a fresh controlled 250-USDC capital-layout comparison including at least 2x125, 3x~83.33, 4x62.50 and 5x50, with exact-three-year baseline and stress evidence plus activity/utilization metrics.
A05/A08 quantify whether long holds and slot saturation explain low portfolio turnover, including NO_FREE_SLOT opportunity loss and zero-position/full-slot time for each layout.

A10 must challenge the prior 2x125 conclusion rather than inherit it: synthesize profitability, drawdown, turnover, utilization and robustness evidence and state whether evidence supports retaining 2x125 or promoting a different research candidate.

A09 and A11 independently reject any capital-layout conclusion that is based only on higher trade count or only on headline return; exact same-history/risk/cost comparability and robustness are mandatory.

A02/A05/A08 must compare the production baseline 2x125 ranked_repeat directly against 5x50 one_per_symbol as the owner's intended five-independent-position model, in addition to ranked_repeat slot-count variants.
A06 supplies a successful simulated full 1x50 BUY+SELL+reconciliation roundtrip and failure/restart evidence for timeout, partial fill, missing fills, duplicate advance and residual mismatch.
A07 proves the concrete Binance adapter sends MARKET BUY with quoteOrderQty=50.00 and MARKET SELL with explicit owned quantity, then queries /api/v3/order and /api/v3/myTrades.
A02/A08 prove canonical Backtest/Paper/Trial/Live entry and exit semantics are aligned and explicitly document unavoidable execution-model differences.
A03 proves pre-existing account balances are baseline-only and never become bot-owned sellable quantity.
A04 proves the real browser operator flow does not enable normal Live before trial COMPLETED and surfaces unresolved/reconciliation states.
A10/A09/A11 all pass on the exact same commit with no missing roundtrip evidence.
A02 produces a fresh latest-head exact-three-year baseline/stress result for all ten coins and reports Top-8 and robust finalists per coin.
A05/A06 provide bounded evidence-led second-stage search proposals or implemented research-only candidate neighborhoods for every coin that lacks a robust finalist.
A10 reports an explicit ten-row coin status: current result, best robust challenger if any, validation/full/stress deltas, drawdown effect, portfolio compatibility and next action.
A09/A11 reject any statement that all ten improved unless all ten independently satisfy the unchanged robust coin gate.
A05 proves the preserved Paper runtime is fresh again on the exact current strategy version without a ledger reset.
A01 records an experiment ledger/current evidence summary preventing silent repetition of previously rejected search regions.
A02/A03/A08 produce ETH M19-vs-M20 trade and slot-collision counterfactual evidence before any new broad ETH grid.
Every serious challenger reports isolated and 250-USDC portfolio baseline/stress plus added/removed/shifted trades, occupied-slot-hour delta and displaced-coin PnL.
Allocator/ranking research is run only with frozen coin profiles and fixed 250-USDC total capital.
A01 proves the promotion diff is limited to the two approved coin profiles plus orchestration/authorization metadata.
A02 proves fresh exact-three-year base/stress results on the promoted canonical profile map.
A03/A05 prove Paper/runtime strategy identity is c78c8cabf980 with preserved history and no reset.
A09 emits QA_PASS and A11 emits GOVERNANCE_PASS on the exact same promotion commit.
The downloadable ZIP commit SHA is identical to the exact commit validated by A01-A11.
coordination_requirements: Use the latest gpt/usdc-audit product head, never an older release/main bootstrap state.

Trace and repair every gate from UI credential status through authenticated-preflight boundary, trial state, runtime/version identity, fresh signal, risk/capital, order/fill/reconciliation and production Live eligibility.
Cloud remains key-free and order-free; any condition that needs real Binance credentials must end in a precise local diagnostic, not a guessed PASS.
Any patch invalidates affected/downstream evidence and requires a fresh pinned run.
A10 must name the repair owner for every blocker; A09/A11 must reject mixed/stale evidence.
